history.summary: Brand-new 2024 484 sqft 1BR at Midwood, 360m from Hillview DTL in D23. Priced at $1,808 psf, below the $1,884 median, but appreciation is soft (1.8%/yr resale-only after new-launch bias adjustment) and the OCR Hillview pocket has limited catalysts.
history.rating_rationale: Strong MRT proximity (360m to Hillview) and a sub-median entry are positives, but the new-launch bias flag is on and the honest resale-only rate is just 1.8%/yr. Hillview is a quiet, supply-heavy OCR enclave with several competing recent launches (The Reserve Residences area, Hillhaven, etc.). Score 560 (market-typical). Low elo (977) reflects weak comparative strength.
red_flags: New-launch bias flagged; honest resale-only appreciation only 1.8%/yr
Hillview OCR pocket with competing nearby new launches diluting resale demand
catalysts: 360m to Hillview DTL — strong direct MRT access
